species.name: Frizzy
species.flavor: "Can control fire. The flames on its back never extinguish"

species.name: Gogo
species.flavor: "Dodo has evolved into a beautiful new bird. This bird can carry heavy loads and run at high speed"

species.name: Kernel
species.flavor: "An independant soldier that strives to protect his breed"

species.name: Leetle
species.flavor: " Likes to live on trees. Though small in size, this little monster packs quite a bit of power."

species.name: Lizzy
species.flavor: "Lives on the Volcano. When angered, it shoots fire out of the holes on its back"

species.name: Luminous
species.flavor: "No longer needs electricity to glitter. No one knows why."

species.name: Luxx
species.flavor: "Glitters when absorbing electricity. Has high survivability."

species.name: Maize
species.flavor: "An ordinary bushel of corn was blessed with life, giving it the ability to think for itself"

species.name: Phony
species.flavor: " Carved out of magical wood. Dreams of carrying riders one day."

species.name: Armon
species.flavor: "This is actually a mouse, but it rolled around over a bunch of rocks to encase its body in thick armor."

species.name: Armordillo
species.flavor: "This monster is even larger than Armon. It looks nothing like a mouse anymore.."

species.name: Bloom
species.flavor: "Leader of an army of roses. It is so beautiful that all creatures are charmed by its presence."

species.name: Blossom
species.flavor: "This young flower is not yet in full bloom"

species.name: Bud
species.flavor: "This little thing is waiting to grow into a flower"

species.name: Chowda
species.flavor: "This timid little thing is always huddling in its shell."

species.name: Flare
species.flavor: "Lives in hot climates. Shoots fire out of its mouth"

species.name: Fright
species.flavor: "Uses the power of lightning to strengthen itself,it is so powerful that it doesn't fear dragons"

species.name: Fritz
species.flavor: "The strange pattern on its body appeared one time when it absorbed too much electricity"

species.name: Frizz
species.flavor: "Absorbs lightning. Warns enemies not to get too close"

species.name: Furocity
species.flavor: "The flames along the outside of its body can never be extinguished."

species.name: Furor
species.flavor: "Surrounded by a wreath of flames. Has incredible power."

species.name: Geo
species.flavor: " Flew out of an erupting volcano. Has a very high temperate.."

species.name: Gnasher
species.flavor: "Respected and powerful. No one dares to bully it."

species.name: Igneous
species.flavor: "Formed from a great collectiong of rocks. The embodiment of teamwork."

species.name: Katch
species.flavor: "Easily Bullied due to its small size"

species.name: Mythik
species.flavor: "Has unusual purple eyes and very powerful psychic abilities"

species.name: Ripper
species.flavor: "Not easily bullied due to its vicious teeth"

species.name: Shelly
species.flavor: "In spite of its hard shell, it is a timid thing."

species.name: Blocky
species.flavor: "The rocks on this monster's body have been reinforced to make it a stronger, better guard."

species.name: Branchy
species.flavor: This big tree is covered in durians. Chucks durians at its opponents when angry.

species.name: Bubbles
species.flavor: " Lives deep in the ocean, out of the reach of normal creatures. Its skin is pink due to the lack of sunlight"

species.name: Champ
species.flavor: This fully grown chimp loves to cause mischief, but everyone is too afraid to chase after it.

species.name: Chimp
species.flavor: "It's almost as if this chimp just escaped from the circus."

species.name: Crabby
species.flavor: "Has a hard shell of armor on its back"

species.name: Crusty
species.flavor: "This aggressive warrior is covered in battle scars"

species.name: Electroe
species.flavor: "The evolved form of Poe after eating Honey (Electric). Its fur generates static electricity."

species.name: Escarglow
species.flavor: "A rare snail that lives in the depths of the Volcano. Its hard shell can withstand high temeratures."

species.name: Grubby
species.flavor: "It digs tunnels underground with its flat snout. It often digs in the wrong place, due to its lack of intellect."

species.name: Hydroe
species.flavor: " The evolved form of Poe after eating Honey (Water). This tranquil beast cannot stand high temperatures."

species.name: Infernoe
species.flavor: "The evolved form of Poe after eating Honey (Fire). Shoots flames out of its paws"

species.name: Lambush
species.flavor: This little sheep thinks it is green and hides in bushes for camouflage, but its white fleece always gives it away

species.name: Lupa
species.flavor: " Carries its young in a pouch on its belly. No one knows how Lupas breed."

species.name: Mineroe
species.flavor: "The evolved form of Poe after eating Honey (Earth). It likes to chew on mud."

species.name: Octobud
species.flavor: Hides behind the flowers bud on its back, killing its enemies in ambush.

species.name: Octomom
species.flavor: While intimidating to look at, this monster is actually quite meek.

species.name: Psychoe
species.flavor: "The evolved form of Poe after eating Honey (Psychic). Has mysterious powers."

species.name: Ricky
species.flavor: "This monster used to guard a temple. Then one day, it suddenly gained self-awareness.."

species.name: Rocky
species.flavor: "Attended a boxing match once. It won a belt for its victory."

species.name: Sally
species.flavor: "The gems around its head can trigger lightning strikes. Legend has it that these gems can help some other monsters evolve."

species.name: Securitey
species.flavor: "Thanks to its thick armor of slime, this monster is protected against any physical attacks."

species.name: Sorcerey
species.flavor: Rare

species.name: Stinger
species.flavor: "Flies by generating its own electricity. It is said to have relatives that live in the ocean."

species.name: Twiggy
species.flavor: Covered in thorns to keep others at bay.

species.name: Vegetaboe
species.flavor: "The evolved form of Poe after eating Honey (Plant). Loves nature and planting trees."

species.name: Bluegway
species.flavor: "This tortoise grew too fast and suffered growing pains. That's why he's always looking so sleepy."

species.name: Boomer
species.flavor: "Can stab through anything with its horn. It fears no enemies."

species.name: Boopie
species.flavor: "Made up entirely of rocks, so it has no fear of being hit. However, the day after a fight it might feel a bit sore."

species.name: Brawny
species.flavor: "It stands out among a herd of Boomers and has the power to do quite a bit of damage."

species.name: Cygness
species.flavor: "This magnificent bird can walk on water. It can be identified by its unique tail."

species.name: Draco
species.flavor: "This Young dragonling can only blink its bright, Innocent eyes"

species.name: Draconio
species.flavor: "This adolescent is almost the size of a full-grown dragon. However, if has trouble controlling its powers."

species.name: Draconius
species.flavor: "Became the leader of a flight of dragons through countless victories. Safeguards the treasures of its flight"

species.name: Flicker
species.flavor: "This little horse is too young to know how to truly master the element of fire"

species.name: Ignightmare
species.flavor: "Gallops from dream to dream. Is the sworn enemy of Felicity"

species.name: Mantis
species.flavor: "A praying mantis that has been sealed in a rock. It bears a stronger resemblance to a rock with each passing day."

species.name: Neo
species.flavor: "Able to turn matter into electricity. Produces currents when angry"

species.name: Neon
species.flavor: "It evolved from Neo, using a Lightning Bead seized from other monsters. Holds the power of heavens."

species.name: Oogway
species.flavor: "This little cutie grows coral on its back."

species.name: Pewgway
species.flavor: "This giant tortoise is so powerful that it is on par with dragons."

species.name: Rhor
species.flavor: "The most powerful monster to ever exist. It is said that the only thing that can defeat it is a legendary bird." (False)

species.name: Scythe
species.flavor: "Now that its body has completely calcified, its forearms have turned into deadly scythes."

species.name: Seafoam
species.flavor: "This bird prefers swimming over flying. It acknowledges its heritage through its unique tail feathers"

species.name: Searbiscuit
species.flavor: "Not easy to get close to, due to the intense heat generated by its body"

species.name: Slider
species.flavor: "Likes to climb onto bamboo shoots. Difficult to find"

species.name: Smiter
species.flavor: "Evolved from snake to dragon using the magic of an enchanted dragon scale. Gained incredible power."

species.name: Swiper
species.flavor: "Once its skin was shed, it grew legs! This monster is special because it changes species when evolving."

species.name: Thor
species.flavor: "Came out of nowhere. Extremely violent and territorial."

species.name: Devil
species.flavor: "Arrived here from a world full of dragons and plans to conquer this land."

species.name: Echo
species.flavor: "Created by a wizard out of cats and bats. It is the embodiment of evil."

species.name: Freezy
species.flavor: "This penguin is a curious little creature. It is easily recognizable, thanks to the yellow feather on its head."

species.name: Pampurred
species.flavor: " This young kitty is learning yoga."

species.name: Setanic
species.flavor: "Descended from titans. Its shell was formed by rocks and provides armor for its entire body."

species.name: Angelo
species.flavor: "Arrived here from a world of dragons and plans to conquer this land."

species.name: Behemoth
species.flavor: "This mythical beast grazes on prairie grass. It is said to be one of the toughest monsters in the world."

species.name: Cerberus
species.flavor: "This three-headed hound guards the gates to the Underworld. He's the loyal servant of Hades.."

species.name: Chimera
species.flavor: "Its body was formed by parts of multiple animals. No one understood how this savage and violent creature can to be."

species.name: Gryphion
species.flavor: "This monster has the head and claws of an eagle. It absorbed the force of thunder to gain lightning speed."

species.name: Hydra
species.flavor: "This multi-headed serpent can have up to nine heads. This magnificent beast stands out over all others."

species.name: Lava
species.flavor: "Arrived here from a world of dragons and plans to conquer the land"

species.name: Leshy
species.flavor: "Arrived here from a world of dragons and plans to conquer this land"

species.name: Minotaur
species.flavor: "A beast with the head of a bull on the body of a man. Few have survived encounters with it."

species.name: Phoenix
species.flavor: "This immortal bird is reborn every one thousand years"

species.name: Plantosaurus
species.flavor: "Bears a holy tree on its back. This strong beast is blessed by the spirits of nature."

species.name: Roco
species.flavor: "Arrived here from a world of dragons and plans to conquer this land."

species.name: Splashy
species.flavor: "Arrived here from a world of dragons and plans to conquer this land."
